brief:
Israel accused Turkey of "dangerous adventures in Syria" on Thursday, according to Reuters, escalating rhetoric two days after an Israeli airstrike on a Syrian airbase. Turkey's government responded by calling for a halt to what it described as "reckless" Israeli military operations in Syrian territory, marking a sharp diplomatic turn between the two regional powers.

The exchange underscored competing interests in Syria and deepening tensions over cross-border military activity. Both countries have maintained active military presences in Syria, with Israel conducting repeated airstrikes against targets it says pose security threats, while Turkey operates ground forces in northern Syrian territory. The specific circumstances of the airbase bombing and the strategic calculations driving each country's Syria policy remained central points of disagreement.

title: Israel and Turkey trade accusations over Syrian airbase strike
